couplets.en: At every hour I long for my beloved.
I sit and send the crows flying.

lines: Aap vanjhaan ke main qaasad bhejaan
couplets.en: Shall I go myself, or send a messenger?
Longing has left me sick.

lines: Ghulam Farida, main taan oven vichhri
couplets.en: Farid, this is how I came to be parted.
I am like a crane parted from its flock.
A lifetime has passed on tiptoe.
You never sent word to ease my heart.
Dark cloud, hold back your rain a little longer.
A lifetime has passed on tiptoe.
The flowers have turned dark.
You went away and became a stranger.

lines: Kamli kar ke chhor ditto ee
couplets.en: You drove me wild with longing and left me.

lines: Kamli kar ke chhor ditto ee
couplets.en: You drove me wild with longing and left me.

lines: Kamli kar ke chhor ditto ee
couplets.en: You drove me wild with longing and left me.

lines: Te baithi kakh galiyaan de rolaan
couplets.en: I sit scattering straw in the lanes.

lines: Ghulam Farida, main taan dozakh sarsaan
couplets.en: Farid, may I burn in hell.

lines: Je main mukh maahi vallon moraan
couplets.en: May it be so if I ever turn my face from my beloved.
The flowers have turned dark.
The flowers have turned dark.
Dark cloud, hold back your rain a little longer.
A lifetime has passed on tiptoe.

lines: Andron andar vagda rehnda paani dard hayati da
couplets.en: The water of a lifetime's sorrow keeps flowing deep within.
The red date palms rise tall.
Lightning strikes my bare skin.
My poor eyes keep weeping.
My body bears every one of those wounds.
Farid, give your heart where it will be cherished.
